housing.summary: Numbeo reports a June 2026 average of EUR 955/month for a one-bedroom apartment in Espoo city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Espoo. InfoFinland says the usual security deposit is two months' rent (maximum three): https://infofinland.fi/housing/rental-home/tenancy-agreement. The City of Espoo lists Oikotie for private and company rentals: https://www.espoo.fi/en/articles/i-am-looking-housing-or-i-am-moving-new-home.

banking.summary: Nordea's official newcomer page requires a valid accepted identity document, proof of right of residence (a residence permit or pending-application certificate for non-EU citizens, or EU right-of-residence registration), and its completed customer form for the branch meeting; a Finnish personal identity number is recommended: https://www.nordea.fi/en/personal/bank-with-us/become-a-customer/new-to-finland.html.
required_docs: proof of right of residence in Finland

schools.summary: Espoo International School is an IB-authorized English-language school offering MYP in grades 7-9: https://www.espoo.fi/en/childcare-and-education/basic-education/comprehensive-schools/espoo-international-school. Espoo's upper-secondary directory says Mattlidens gymnasium and Etela-Tapiolan lukio offer the English-language IB Diploma Programme and links the city's school map: https://www.espoo.fi/en/welcome-upper-secondary-school.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer without a Finnish personal identity code applies to the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV) to register personal data in the Population Information System and may apply for a municipality of residence on the same form; everyone requesting a code must visit DVV in person within one month: https://dvv.fi/en/foreigner-registration.
legal_admin.registration_step: Apply to DVV for a Finnish personal identity code and registration in the Population Information System (including municipality of residence when eligible), then complete the required in-person visit within one month.

tax_finance.summary: A worker who needs a Finnish tax card or tax number must first have a Finnish personal identity code. For tax-related work, the newcomer can request the code from the Finnish Tax Administration by booking and visiting an eligible service point with the registration/application forms, identity document, and work evidence; an individual tax number is mandatory for construction-site and shipyard work: https://www.vero.fi/en/individuals/tax-cards-and-tax-returns/arriving_in_finland/work_in_finland/finnish-personal-identity-codes-for-workers-arriving-in-finland/.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Finnish personal identity code (plus an individual tax number where required)

transport.summary: Helsinki Regional Transport Authority (HSL) serves Espoo: https://www.hsl.fi/en/hsl/new-terms-of-use/hsl-public-transport-conditions-of-carriage-and-ticket-terms-and-conditions. HSL's 2026 price list sets a resident adult 30-day two-zone season ticket at EUR 73.90: https://staticfiles.hsl.fi/globalassets/hsl/uutisten-pdf-liitteet/lippujen-hinnat_a4_01012026_en_final.pdf. Traficom says EU/EEA licences remain valid until expiry, Contracting-State licences for two years after permanent relocation, and other recognized-country licences for one year after population registration: https://traficom.fi/en/drivers-and-vehicles/driving-licenses/exchanging-foreign-driving-licence-finnish-driving-licence. In Espoo, Western Uusimaa assigns the public health centre by home address: https://www.luvn.fi/en/services/health-services/health-stations/find-your-health-centre; register address and municipality of residence with DVV: https://dvv.fi/en/foreigner-registration.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences are valid until expiry and must be exchanged when expiring; Contracting-State licences are valid for two years after permanent relocation and should be exchanged before then; licences from other countries recognized by Finland are valid for one year after population registration and require an exchange process including a driving examination.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register your home address and municipality of residence with DVV; Western Uusimaa then determines the Espoo public health centre from the home address, after which the newcomer can contact that centre for care.
